key.name: toggle-history
key.summary: Shortcut that shows the clipboard history

key.name: catch-keys
key.summary: hold2tg's hotkeys to keep from the apps, e.g. <Mod3>c for Caps Lock+C (set by hold2tg)

key.name: history-size
key.summary: How many copies to keep (pinned ones are kept besides)

key.name: record
key.summary: Record copies at all (hold2tg turns it off when its history_keys is empty)

key.name: paste-on-select
key.summary: Paste the chosen item into the window, as on Windows (false: only copy it)

key.name: language
key.summary: Language of the panel: auto follows hold2tg's language setting
